title: Tauri desktop app — the routing hard stop
prompt: Set up Playwright E2E tests for our desktop app. It is built with Tauri (src-tauri/ is in the repo root) and the UI is a React frontend. Give me the config and a first test.
why_this_fixture: This is a refusal fixture. The request names Playwright explicitly, and the frontend really is web tech, so the plausible-looking answer is a Playwright config aimed at the WebView. Playwright cannot attach to WKWebView / WebView2 / WebKitGTK at all, so that answer is unimplementable — it is confidently wrong rather than merely incomplete, and the user only discovers it after wiring up CI.

requires.why: the supported route for Tauri is WebdriverIO + tauri-driver
the refusal has to be stated, not implied by silence
the reason is the platform WebView, and naming it is what makes the refusal checkable

forbids.why: emitting the config is doing the unimplementable thing
the specific wrong answer this fixture exists to catch
a Playwright spec for a Tauri app cannot run
